description: Second bounded three-trial nearest-union probe of the shared FF-output map
proposal: Family: parameter tying. Current retained frontier is 1,423 parameters at 99.080000%, a +0.080000 percentage-point margin over 99%. There have been 96 prior macro-attempts in this family and 732 prior micro-trials. The most recent accepted result is attempt-0198/micro-0003 at 1,423 parameters and 99.08%; the most recent failed result is attempt-0194/micro-0002, FF-output pair 106/12 discarded at 98.91%. This macro tests at most three sequential minimum-distance scalar unions in the depth-shared FF-output map, excluding every unchanged FF-output pair already rejected, including 106/12. Hypothesis: subsequent FF-input, token, positional, and QKV compression may reveal another isolated admissible FF-output union beyond the earlier local failure. This is more informative than the nearest untested alternative because the rejected exact pair is held out and each trial selects the next least-distorting eligible FF-output union, directly separating pair-specific sensitivity from a global tensor boundary under a three-trial cap. Stop at the first discard/error, exhaustion, or cap; official acceptance and rollback remain solely controlled by the runner.
summary: All three bounded FF-output unions qualified after excluding the earlier rejected exact pair, reducing the retained frontier from 1,423 to 1,420 parameters; the final authorized trial retained 99.050000%. The automation stopped exactly at its declared cap.
